facts.text: SLS Baha Mar is part of Baha Mar, a resort destination in The Bahamas.
facts.excerpt: SLS Baha Mar is part of Baha Mar, The Bahamas’ newest luxury resort destination

facts.text: SLS Baha Mar sits inside the larger Baha Mar complex in Nassau.
facts.excerpt: Inside the larger Baha Mar complex in Nassau, The Bahamas

facts.text: The hotel is a short drive from Cable Beach and about 15 minutes from downtown Nassau.
facts.excerpt: you’re a short drive from Cable Beach and about 15 minutes from downtown Nassau

facts.text: Baha Mar opened in phases starting in 2017.
facts.excerpt: Baha Mar opened in phases starting in 2017, designed as a self-contained resort complex with multiple hotels, restaurants, and shared amenities.

facts.text: Within Baha Mar, SLS sits alongside Grand Hyatt and Rosewood, and is positioned as the most design-forward and nightlife-driven of the three hotels.
facts.excerpt: SLS is positioned as the most design-forward and nightlife-driven of the three hotels, alongside Grand Hyatt and Rosewood.

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites reflect a combination of modern baroque and Caribbean flair.
facts.excerpt: luxurious, airy guest rooms and suites reflect a combination of modern baroque and Caribbean flare

facts.text: Superior rooms have Bahama-style shutters and locally designed furniture.
facts.excerpt: Bahama-style shutters and locally-designed furniture add Caribbean style to decor

facts.text: Rooms come with Ortigia Sicilia bath amenities.
facts.excerpt: Ortigia Sicilia Bath Amenities

facts.text: The residences have fully equipped kitchens and floor-to-ceiling glass doors.
facts.excerpt: The spacious living area includes a queen-size pullout sofa and a fully equipped kitchen. Floor-to-ceiling glass doors reveal stunning ocean and resort views.

facts.text: Carna Baha Mar is a contemporary steakhouse helmed by butcher Dario Cecchini.
facts.excerpt: Contemporary steakhouse helmed by the legendary butcher, Dario Cecchini

facts.text: Katsuya Baha Mar serves a contemporary take on classic Japanese cuisine.
facts.excerpt: A fresh and artful take on classic Japanese cuisine

facts.text: 25° North serves Southern California coastal cuisine with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Southern California coastal cuisine with breathtaking ocean views

facts.text: The hotel lobby is anchored by the Monkey Bar.
facts.excerpt: The lobby, anchored by the Monkey Bar, sets that tone upon arrival.

facts.text: SkyBar is an open-air bar on the hotel's 20th floor.
facts.excerpt: Set on the hotel’s 20th floor, the open-air space looks out over the property

facts.text: Privilege Baha Mar is an upscale adults-only pool party with cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Upscale adults-only pool party and cabanas

facts.text: Children ages 0-5 who are hotel guests eat free from the kids menu at Cleo, Carna and Katsuya and other venues.
facts.excerpt: Children ages 0-5 can enjoy a complimentary meal from the kids menu at Cleo, Carna, and Katsuya

facts.text: SLS Baha Mar guests can use the Baha Bay beachfront waterpark.
facts.excerpt: A luxury beachfront waterpark from Baha Mar accessible for SLS Baha Mar guests.

facts.text: Baha Bay has a FlowCurl surf simulator that requires no lessons.
facts.excerpt: Experience the thrill of surfing with no lessons required, on this fun, state-of-the-art FlowCurl surf simulator.

facts.text: Baha Bay has a kids' area with twisty slides and a tipping bucket.
facts.excerpt: Speed down twisty slides, get drenched by the tipping bucket and splash through the battle zone in this kids’ area designed for maximum adventure.

facts.text: The ESPA at Baha Mar is the first flagship ESPA in the Caribbean.
facts.excerpt: The first flagship ESPA in the Caribbean follows the brand’s location-inspired philosophy

facts.text: The ESPA is shared across the entire Baha Mar complex.
facts.excerpt: The 30,000-square-foot Espa is shared across the entire Baha Mar complex.

facts.text: Royal Blue is an 18-hole, par-72 golf course designed by Jack Nicklaus.
facts.excerpt: Designed by the legendary Jack Nicklaus, Royal Blue is a spectacular 18-hole, par-72 course

facts.text: The John McEnroe Tennis Center at Baha Mar has hard courts, clay courts and pickleball courts.
facts.excerpt: The John McEnroe Tennis Center at Baha Mar serves up six professional hard courts, two Har-Tru clay courts, six pickleball courts

facts.text: Baha Mar has a casino with an ocean view.
facts.excerpt: A casino with an ocean view? Jackpot.

facts.text: The Sanctuary at Baha Mar offers daily animal feedings.
facts.excerpt: The Sanctuary offers daily feedings for curious nature lovers of every age.

facts.text: At the wildlife sanctuary guests can get close to sea turtles, stingrays, nurse sharks and native birds.
facts.excerpt: you can get surprisingly close to sea turtles, stingrays, nurse sharks, and native birds

facts.text: The Current Gallery and Art Center at Baha Mar hosts exhibitions, workshops and lectures on Bahamian art.
facts.excerpt: The Current Gallery and Art Center is a hub for compelling Bahamian artistic experiences

facts.text: Baha Mar has over 40 restaurants, bars and lounges.
facts.excerpt: Choose from over 40 restaurants, bars, and lounges

facts.excerpt: SLS Baha Mar is pleased to welcome canine companions as part of our pet-friendly program.

facts.excerpt: SLS offers accessible rooms and step-free access across many of its main public spaces, including restaurants, pools, and shared facilities.

facts.excerpt: ESPA Baha Mar, the Bahamas’ finest luxury spa
